name: Cenomi
verdict: Cenomi Centers, a Saudi-listed shopping-centre developer; its largest shareholder is the Alhokair family's FAS Real Estate Company (26.89% at 31 December 2025). Nothing in its ownership chain passes the rating test.
note: Al-Ahli partner since December 2024; the Cenomi logo appears on the back of the first team's jersey under the partnership extended to 2031.
